summary: Manages the GPU memory management unit: sets the DMA address width to 40 bits, provides PTE page kind lookups via a 256-entry table mapping page attributes to hardware kind codes, and configures VMM and memory structures for address translation.

dma_bits.what: Sets DMA address width to 40 bits for page table address encoding

kind.what: Returns 256-entry lookup table mapping PTE attributes to hardware page kind codes

kind_sys.what: Flags that the kind lookup table is used for system memory page allocation
